## Learning Goal

What should the learner understand or do after this change?

## Proposed Contract

Owning package, units/frames, state transitions, dependency and VM memory impact,
acceptance tests, alternatives, and explicit non-goals. Explain how HOLD, reset,
source changes, and freshness remain coherent. Planned camera transport is not
evidence of a working camera adapter.
